title: Frontend Developer - Product Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and technically strong **Frontend Developer & Product Manager** who has excellent command over JavaScript and CSS, along with proven experience in managing development teams and leading products from concept to delivery.

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on frontend technology expert who can architect user interfaces, guide developers, manage product roadmaps, coordinate with backend and design teams, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software products.

This role requires someone who can think like a developer, lead like a manager, and make decisions like a product owner.

Key Responsibilities1. Frontend Development & Technical Expertise

* Demonstrate excellent hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Lead frontend architecture and development for web applications and SaaS products.
* Develop responsive, scalable, and user-friendly interfaces.
* Work with modern frontend frameworks such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Ensure frontend performance, browser compatibility, code quality, and maintainability.
* Review code and establish frontend development standards and best practices.
* Guide developers in solving complex technical challenges.

2. Product Management

* Own product planning, roadmap development, and feature prioritisation.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Prepare product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA teams, and stakeholders.
* Monitor product development lifecycle from planning to deployment.
* Collect user feedback and identify opportunities for product improvements.
* Ensure products meet business objectives, usability standards, and delivery timelines.

3. Team Management & Leadership

* Lead, manage, and mentor a team of frontend developers and other technical resources.
* Assign tasks, monitor progress, and ensure accountability.
* Conduct technical discussions, code reviews, and sprint planning.
* Manage project priorities, deadlines, and team productivity.
* Resolve technical and operational bottlenecks.
* Build a collaborative and performance-driven development culture.

Required Technical Skills

* **JavaScript:** Excellent knowledge of core JavaScript, ES6+, DOM manipulation, asynchronous programming, and API integration.
* **CSS:** Strong expertise in CSS3, Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, animations, and modern UI styling.
* HTML5 and semantic markup.
* React.js / Angular / Vue.js.
* REST API integration and JSON.
* Git and version control.
* Understanding of frontend architecture, performance optimisation, and security.
* Familiarity with UI frameworks such as Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, or Material UI.

Required Management Skills

* Proven experience managing and leading a software development team.
* Previous experience as a Product Manager, Technical Lead, or Engineering Lead.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with product roadmaps, sprint planning, and backlog management.
* Excellent communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate between technical teams, management, and clients.
* Strong ownership and accountability for product delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline.
* Experience working on SaaS products, enterprise applications, or B2B platforms.
* Experience managing the complete software development lifecycle.
* Knowledge of AI-powered applications and integration of AI APIs will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with cloud-based applications and microservices will be beneficial.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who:

* Is exceptionally strong in JavaScript and CSS.
* Can independently evaluate frontend architecture and make technical decisions.
* Has successfully managed and motivated a development team.
* Can take ownership of a product rather than simply execute assigned tasks.
* Can balance hands-on coding with product planning and team management.
* Is proactive, accountable, and focused on delivering quality products.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Up to ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Web Development and Designing Intern
description:
The Opportunity: Mentorship over Meetings

Join our team on-site for an intensive, hands-on internship designed to turn students into professional developers. We don’t do "shadowing"—you will be building, breaking, and deploying real-world e-commerce solutions from day one.

What You Will Master (Learning Path)

Shopify Architecture: Go deep into theme customization and build high-conversion storefronts.

Modern PHP: Master CodeIgniter 4 (CI4), focusing on MVC patterns, routing, and database migrations.

API & Integration: Learn how to connect custom backend tools using CI4.

Deployment Workflow: Get comfortable with professional Git workflows and live server environments.

Your Responsibilities

Code Implementation: Develop and maintain clean, scalable code in PHP (CI4) and Shopify.

Frontend Precision: Convert design mockups into responsive, high-performance web pages.

Collaborative Problem Solving: Participate in daily whiteboarding sessions to solve logic hurdles in real-time.

Bug Squashing: Work alongside senior developers to troubleshoot and optimize existing store functionalities.

What We’re Looking For (Requirements)

Core Skills: HTML5, CSS 3.

PHP Curiosity: Basic knowledge of PHP (experience with CI4 or Laravel is a plus).

Logic First: A problem-solving mindset and curiosity about how systems work.

Commitment: Ability to work from our office for the full duration (3–6 months).

Communication: A team player who prefers face-to-face collaboration over digital-only chat.

The "Exit Value" (What’s in it for you?)

Official Internship Certificate: A formal document verifying your tenure and technical skills.

Letter of Recommendation (LOR): A personalized, performance-based LOR from our Lead Developer to help you land your first high-paying job.

Portfolio Growth: Leave with live, production-ready projects to showcase to future employers.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their resume or application details to:

title: Front End Developer
description:
**Job description:**

Front End Developer & Web Designer

About Ace Rooms Ltd

Ace Rooms Ltd is a UK-based B2B travel technology company with over 16 years of experience in global hotel and transfer distribution. The platform enables travel agents and API partners to search live inventory, book hotels and transfers, and manage payments. The company is currently rebuilding its platform on Microsoft Azure with a modern Angular 19 frontend, targeting a clean, contemporary design aligned to European travel industry standards.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Front-End Developer & Web Designer to join our team and take ownership of the visual and interactive layer of our platform. The role combines frontend development (Angular Latest / HTML / CSS / JavaScript) with graphic design responsibilities, including HTML email design and distribution. The successful candidate will help deliver a modern, user-friendly interface for a global B2B travel audience.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain frontend interfaces using Angular (Latest Version), HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.
* Implement UI/UX designs across key platform screens: search, results, guest checkout, booking management, and transfer flows.
* Ensure the platform presents a modern, professional appearance consistent with European travel website standards.
* Design and build HTML emails; manage distribution to the client mailing list.
* Create graphic design assets including banners, brochures, flyers using Photoshop.
* Maintain and update the company website; apply SEO best practices to improve visibility and performance.
* Collaborate with the back-end development team to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data presentation.
* Keep designs current, fresh, and aligned with brand guidelines as the platform evolves.
* Prepare and maintain project-related documentation, reports, and correspondence using MS Office.

Essential Skills & Experience

* **Frontend Development —** Proficient in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. Ability to manage and update WordPress-based web pages.
* **Angular —** Working knowledge of Angular (experience with Angular 19 or latest versions preferred).
* **Graphic Design —** Adobe Photoshop; ability to produce professional layouts, banners.
* **Email Design —** Experience designing and sending HTML emails to client mailing lists.
* **SEO —** Practical knowledge of on-page SEO techniques, meta tags, site structure, and performance optimisation to improve search visibility.
* **Version Control** — Git knowledge is worth stating since you'll be working with GitHub
* **MS Office —** Competent in Word, Excel, and related tools.
* **Communication —** Fluent written and spoken English is essential.
* **Attention to Detail —** Strong eye for design, layout consistency, and user experience.

Desirable Skills

* Prior experience working for a travel company or within the travel industry.
* Familiarity with Azure Web Apps or cloud-hosted frontend deployments.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions) for frontend builds.
* Experience with Angular Material component library.

Qualifications

* Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Design, Computer Science, IT, or equivalent).
* Minimum 2 years of experience in a front-end development or web design role.

What We Offer

* An opportunity to shape the look and feel of a brand-new platform serving a global B2B travel audience.
* Full-time, permanent employment with an established international travel-technology company.
* Structured working hours: Monday to Friday, 12:00 Noon – 9:00 PM IST.
* Salary negotiable based on experience and demonstrated skills.

**Pay:** ₹50,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month Depending on experience

To arrange an interview: Call 9674488751 or 9321580721

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
